action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-validate/adm
echo "=== follow admin SSO start ==="
curl -sS -m 15 -b a_cookies.txt -c a_cookies.txt -o a_start.html -w 'final:%{url_effective}\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' -L http://localhost:8080/admin/login/start
echo "--- body head ---"; head -c 400 a_start.html; echo
echo "--- forms/fields ---"
grep -oE '<(form|a)[^>]*(action|href)="[^"]*"' a_start.html | head -8
grep -o 'name="state" value="[^"]*"' a_start.html | head -1
grep -oE 'action="[^"]*"' a_start.html | head -2
